eightBarFormsIntro.sentenceDescription: Sentences have two subphrases: presentation + continuation. The presentation consists of the basic idea and repetition. Continuation has the same length as presentation. In addition, it typically has 4 key traits: fragmentation, more rhythmic activity, sequences, faster harmonic rhythm.
eightBarFormsIntro.periodDescription: Two subphrases (antecedent + consequent), each consisting of a basic idea and contrasting idea. The antecedent ends in a weaker cadence, while the consequent ends in a stronger cadence. In other words, the antecedent asks, and the consequent answers.

eightBarForms.name: Sentence
eightBarForms.description: Presentation + continuation. The presentation consists of the basic idea and repetition. Continuation has the same length as presentation.

eightBarForms.name: Period
eightBarForms.description: Two subphrases (antecedent + consequent), each consisting of a basic idea and contrasting idea.

eightBarForms.name: Hybrid 1
eightBarForms.description: First half is a period subphrase, finished by a sentence subphrase.

eightBarForms.name: Hybrid 2
eightBarForms.description: First half is a period subphrase, finished by something like a sentence subphrase (less about fragmentation, more about cadential setup)

eightBarForms.name: Hybrid 3
eightBarForms.description: The first half is a compound basic idea. The compound basic idea is a hybrid subphrase with a period-like structure (BI + CI) and sentence-like harmony (no cadence). This is then finished like a sentence.

eightBarForms.name: Hybrid 4
eightBarForms.description: The first half is a hybrid subphrase with a period-like structure (BI + CI) and sentence-like harmony (no cadence). This is then finished like a period.

smallForms.name: Small Binary
smallForms.description: First and second parts are usually an 8-measure theme. Second part should not have a recapitulation, and can be contrasting or similar to the first part.

smallForms.name: Small Ternary
smallForms.description: First part contains an exposition, usually an 8-measure theme. Second part starts with a contrasting middle (variable length), and ends with a recapitulation using material from the exposition (4-8 measures).
